title: Squeezing a fluid gently
hook: Change pressure increase and predict volume strain magnitude.
misconception: volume strain magnitude stays fixed when pressure increase doubles.
objective: Apply ΔV/V = ΔP/B to compare volume strain magnitude when pressure increase changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With small compression with fixed bulk modulus, ΔV/V = ΔP/B. When pressure increase doubles, volume strain magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ΔV/V = ΔP/B; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider small compression with fixed bulk modulus, with a nonzero initial result. If pressure increase triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on volume strain magnitude?
recall.why: Apply ΔV/V = ΔP/B under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
